sloka: अथ दाशरथी रामो रौद्रमस्त्रं प्रयोजयन्।कुम्भकर्णस्य हृदये ससर्ज निशितान् शरान् ।। ६.६७.१०५ ।।
transliteration: atha dāśarathī rāmo raudramastraṁ prayojayan।kumbhakarṇasya hṛdaye sasarja niśitān śarān ।। 6.67.105 ।।

translations.english: Then he covered Kumbhakarna's glittering golden shield with arrows just as the evening wind covered the cloud.
